acne vulgaris.d: the most common form of acne; usually affects people from puberty to young adulthood

acne rosacea.d: a skin disease of adults (more often women) in which blood vessels of the face enlarge resulting in a flushed appearance

acne.d: an inflammatory disease involving the sebaceous glands of the skin; characterized by papules or pustules or comedones

acned.d: blemished by imperfections of the skin
